records.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR telemetry name resolves to the Lotus Elise GT1, also called the Lotus GT1 Turbo and identified in secondary technical histories as Type 115. This is the 1997 FIA GT race car, built around a heavily modified Elise-derived aluminium structure with a carbon-fibre body and a six-speed Hewland sequential transmission. Keep it separate from the earlier Lotus Esprit GT1/Type 114, the single road homologation Elise GT1 with a Lotus 918 V8 and Renault five-speed manual, and later Bitter GT1 conversions that used revised bodies, different engines, or different transmissions.
